Interface GamePhaseState

All Known Implementing Classes:
DrawPhaseState, EndGamePhaseState, EndRoundPhaseState, EndTurnPhaseState, OptionalDrawPhaseState, PlayEventPhaseState, SetupPhaseState
interface GamePhaseState
Represents a single state in the game phase state machine.

Each concrete implementation encapsulates the entry logic and transition rules for one game phase. The GameManager holds the current state and delegates phase progression to it via nextPhase(GameManager).
